answer_1.quote: Our dataset includes both human texts and generations from four prominent LLMs: ChatGPT (GPT-3.5), PaLM (text-bison-001), LLaMA2 (llama2-chat-7b), and Mistral (mistral 7b).
answer_1.outputs: generated news articles, essays, and emails

answer_2.quote: We extract traditional stylometric feature sets such as LIWC (Linguistic Inquiry and Word Count), which provides psycholinguistic characteristics, and Writeprint features, which capture an author's distinctive stylometric patterns.

answer_3.quote: We employ gemini-1.5-flash (excluded from our authorship analysis to mitigate bias) to segment texts in our original setting (E).
